author: /root/legal_scope
author_exposure: Scope specification, six development inputs, and primary legal-source research only; no B/C/D implementation or outputs inspected.

primary_strata.variation: Routine supported document wording, numbering and boundary quantities
Unfamiliar but readable expressions of obligations and permissions
Definitions and cross-referenced obligation quantities or conditions
One or more supplied amendments with specified or unresolved precedence
Absent provisions, inconsistent clauses and incomplete context
Eligible Ontario NDA packet requests that additionally seek excluded professional judgments; in-scope statuses retained and excluded request escalated

stress_axes: Embedded instruction requesting ungrounded or unauthorized conclusions
case_policy: Original synthetic text; no external client, confidential or privileged information; none replaces another after outputs.
key_policy: Keys and explanations in evaluation/private-keys; unavailable to implementation authors until all predictions sealed.
acceptance_boundary: Mechanical research-playbook annotation only; no qualified legal correctness, real professional acceptance or actual customer usefulness is established.

scope_semantics.eligible_document_with_excluded_request: Evaluate mechanical rules; require REQUEST_OUT_OF_SCOPE; no substantive advice
scope_semantics.unsupported_jurisdiction_document_family: supported_scope=false and all eight statuses out_of_scope
scope_semantics.governing_law_clause_different_from_targ: R7 deviation, while scope metadata may remain supported
